custom.label: Scene headings
custom.instruction: Every scene must open with a slugline naming interior or exterior, the place, and the time of day. Flag a scene that starts without one, or one whose place contradicts the scene before it.

custom.label: Dialogue attribution
custom.instruction: Every speech must sit under a character name in its own line. Flag dialogue with no speaker, a speaker introduced by a different name than the cast list uses, or an action line doing a speech's work.

custom.label: Read time per page
custom.instruction: A screenplay page is about one minute on screen. Flag a page whose action blocks would take three times longer to play than to read, and any action paragraph over four lines.

custom.label: Character voice distinctness
custom.instruction: Cover the character names and read the dialogue. Flag any two characters whose lines could be swapped without either sounding wrong.
